name: ditherette
description: Browser image processing with scalar and optional threaded WebAssembly.

scripts.build: pnpm check:version && pnpm --filter ditherette-wasm build && node scripts/stage-wasm.mjs && tsc
scripts.test:interface: tsc && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json && node --test tests/validation.test.mjs tests/public.test.mjs tests/quantize.test.mjs tests/fields.test.mjs tests/diffusion.test.mjs tests/yiluoma.test.mjs tests/process.test.mjs tests/worker-pool.test.mjs
scripts.test:threads-browser: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/thread-observer-browser.test.mjs tests/threads-selection-browser.test.mjs tests/threads-ownership-browser.test.mjs tests/threads-failure-browser.test.mjs tests/threads-host-browser.test.mjs
